1	/-

     4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepAffChallenge
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AtlasFromDivRepAff
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ChartAtlasCoupling
     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# The widened divisor representer at the Picard atlas seam
    12	
    13	The widened divisor functor of a challenge curve is represented at the genus parameter.  This
    14	module inserts that representation into the Abel construction and then into the Zariski-local
    15	representability theorem for the degree-zero Picard functor.
    16	
    17	The resulting chart family has no assumed divisor representation.  Its remaining inputs are the
    18	two geometric conditions of the local-representability theorem: every restricted Abel map is a
    19	representable open immersion, and the restricted maps cover the Picard sheaf pointwise.
    20	
    21	This is not an unconditional Picard representability result: the final declaration below retains
    22	both geometric inputs.  Moreover, at the larger admissible coverage parameter the raw Abel map has
    23	positive-dimensional linear-system fibres in positive genus, so the larger divisor representer
    24	cannot simply be substituted as an open chart source.  The remaining datum-tail construction is
    25	the corrected Altman--Kleiman step: represent the quotient by equality of the induced Picard class,
    26	thereby removing those fibres before applying the Picard representability seam.
    27	
    28	## Main declarations
    29	
    30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.abelSigmaChartAffGenus` is the widened Abel chart formed from the chosen
    31	  genus-parameter divisor representer.
    32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.universalDivFamAffGenus` is its universal widened divisor family.
    33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible` is the no-argument widened Abel map at the
    34	  unconditional admissible coverage parameter; its legal chart index is chosen internally.
    35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.universalDivFamAffAdmissible` is the corresponding universal family.
    36	* `AlgebraicGeometry.affineGenusChart` restricts a multi-index family of these maps to chosen
    37	  source opens.
    38	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0RepresentableByOfAffineGenusCharts` is the conditional final assembly
    39	  once the restricted charts are open immersions and cover pointwise.
    40	-/
    41	
    42	set_option autoImplicit false
    43	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    44	
    45	universe u
    46	
    47	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite
    48	
    49	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    50	
    51	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    52	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    53	
    54	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    55	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    56	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    57	
    58	noncomputable section
    59	
    60	/-- The universal widened divisor family carried by the chosen genus-parameter representer. -/
    61	def universalDivFamAffGenus :
    62	    divFamZarAff C (genus C) (divRepAffGenusScheme C) :=
    63	  (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv (𝟙 _)
    64	
    65	/-- Pulling back the chosen universal family gives the widened family classified by the
    66	corresponding morphism into the genus representer. -/
    67	theorem universalDivFamAffGenus_map {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    68	    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
    69	    divFamZarAff.map C (genus C) q (universalDivFamAffGenus C)
    70	      = (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q := by
    71	  have h := (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv_comp q
    72	    (𝟙 (divRepAffGenusScheme C))
    73	  rw [Category.comp_id] at h
    74	  exact h.symm
    75	
    76	/-- The universal widened divisor family carried by the unconditional representer at the
    77	admissible coverage parameter. -/
    78	def universalDivFamAffAdmissible :
    79	    divFamZarAff C (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C) (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C) :=
    80	  (divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C).homEquiv (𝟙 _)
    81	
    82	/-- Pullback of the admissible universal family agrees with classification by the unconditional
    83	admissible representer. -/
    84	theorem universalDivFamAffAdmissible_map {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    85	    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C) :
    86	    divFamZarAff.map C (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C) q
    87	        (universalDivFamAffAdmissible C)
    88	      = (divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C).homEquiv q := by
    89	  have h := (divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C).homEquiv_comp q
    90	    (𝟙 (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C))
    91	  rw [Category.comp_id] at h
    92	  exact h.symm
    93	
    94	/-- The widened Abel chart at the genus parameter, using the challenge curve's chosen divisor
    95	representer rather than accepting a representability witness as an argument. -/
    96	def abelSigmaChartAffGenus
    97	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    98	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
    99	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (genus C : ℤ)) :
   100	    yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 :=
   101	  abelSigmaChartAff C (genus C) (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C) m Z hdeg
   102	
   103	/-- The widened Abel map at the unconditional admissible coverage parameter.  A legal chart
   104	index whose locus is universal is chosen internally; this declaration does not assert that the
   105	raw Abel map is an open immersion or an atlas. -/
   106	def abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible :
   107	    yoneda.obj (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C).left ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 := by
   108	  classical
   109	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
   110	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   111	    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
   112	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
   113	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   114	    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
   115	  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   116	    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
   117	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
   118	    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
   119	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
   120	    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
   121	  let hchart := exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_eq_univ
   122	    (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) (genus C) (chi_moduleKSheaf C)
